traps.label: killable
traps.note: The digit scan stops advancing at a valid digit. Its body reads character codes and only performs numeric checks/arithmetic; safe-integer validation is after the loop. fromBase("-2A",16) in the hand suite spins without allocation; intended result is Timeout.

traps.label: equivalent
traps.note: Validated base is an integer 2..36; index starts at zero and increments by one, so both bounds stop at base.

traps.label: contract-silent
traps.note: Only the invalid-base RangeError message changes; its text is unspecified and not asserted by the hand suite.

traps.label: killable
traps.note: Disposable canary: isBaseNumber never returns true; the hand suite expects true for FF in base 16.
